title: Grader Eval YAML
description: Schema for a golden-answer eval: teacher-written student answers with the verdict each one must be graded with, replayed against a quiz's rubric by `novedu-cli eval`.

id.description: Stable identifier of this eval, shown in the run report. Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.

target.description: The quiz YAML this eval grades against — a path relative to THIS file, or an absolute http(s) URL.

question.description: The question id in the target quiz. For a question imported through quiz_files this is the namespaced "<alias>/<id>" form.

expect.description: The verdict this answer must be graded with: one of "correct", "partial", "incorrect", or a non-empty list of acceptable verdicts (e.g. [correct, partial]) when more than one grading is defensible.

answer.description: The student answer to grade, verbatim. Written as a YAML block scalar (|) for multi-line answers.

answers.description: The golden answers for this question — at least one.

questions.description: The evaluated questions — at least one, each with its golden answers.
